text: OI! LISTEN UP! Nine dollars fifty for a bloody flat white in Fortitude Valley! Nine-fifty! Mate, I've bought a whole CAR for less than that!
action: slams both palms on the desk, headphones half off one ear, jabs a finger straight down the barrel of the mic like a courtroom prosecutor

text: And here's the kicker, right — I know EXACTLY why it happened. I did the sums on a napkin at two in the mornin'. There's a bloke in this city single-handedly holdin' the bean hostage, and I'm namin' him before we're done.
action: leans hard into the mic, unfolds a crumpled napkin and waves it at the camera, wipes sweat off his brow with a forearm

text: Yeah, nah. Mate, you paid nine-fifty 'cause you ordered an oat milk double-shot with a caramel drizzle and a little biscuit on the side. That's not inflation. That's a personality problem.
action: slow blinks twice, chews a gum leaf, adjusts his stubby holder on the desk without ever lifting his elbows

text: Which is WHY this ep is brought to ya by BOOMER'S BEAN BUCKET! Four litres of servo coffee in a paint tin. No barista, no latte art, no bloke named Jarrod askin' if ya want it in a keep cup. Two bucks. GAME CHANGER!
action: hoists a paint tin above his head with both hands like a premiership trophy, shakes it so it sloshes, flexes one bicep at the lens

text: That's not a sponsor, mate. Nobody's payin' us. You bought that tin at Bunnings on Sunday and filled it yourself. Also it's cactus — I saw a moth in it.
action: slouches deep in his chair, gestures at the tin with one lazy finger, takes a long sip from the stubby holder while Boomer keeps posing mid-air

text: Fair dinkum though Kev, be serious — Brissy's gone mad as a cut snake. Rent's up, beans are up, the poor cafe's payin' eight grand a month for a shopfront the size of a dunny. Someone's gotta cop it!
action: drops the tin, shadow boxes twice, then plants his elbows on the desk and points across at Kev like a debater conceding a point

text: Yeah, nah — that bit I'll give ya. Bloody oath. The cafe's not gougin' ya, mate. They're flat out like a lizard drinkin' just to keep the lights on. You're yellin' at the wrong bloke in the apron.
action: nods once, slowly, leans two inches toward the mic — the most effort he's made all episode — then wheezes a dry little laugh

text: So who's the bloke holdin' the bean hostage?! Napkin says it's... the landlord!
action: slaps the napkin flat on the desk, both hands raised in triumph, freezing mid-flex
